limitations: Privileged offline diagnostic only; these coordinates and colliders were not sent to policy.

Positive impulse contact samples selected; ContactFound with zero impulse and lost callbacks excluded. Exact duplicate same-step/pair/point removed; point counts and impulse-magnitude weights are descriptive, not independently calibrated pressure distributions.
Input convex hull bounds and native collider names identify logged input collision shapes; effective PhysX cooked geometry was not independently inspected.
Different controller, grasp TCP height, closure timing and force limits prevent a causal height-only comparison.
Small relative pose drifts describe this simulator diagnostic, not hardware precision.
